name: Why Me?
source:
"With this, you shall protect this kingdom that may befall it until the day that you die."

But what if I don't want that?

"Why Me?" is a visual novel that touches on peer pressure. You are bestowed a weapon in your hand, and a prophecy on your shoulders, which you accepted because of the many eyes on you.

Do you succumb to your fate, or do you run away from it?

[From [url=https://rice373.itch.io/why-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“以此，你将守护这个可能降临的王国，直到你死去的那一天。”

但如果我不想这样怎么办？

“为什么是我？”是一部触及同侪压力的视觉小说。你手中被赋予了武器，肩上被赋予了预言，你接受了它，因为有很多双眼睛注视着你。

你是屈服于命运，还是逃避命运？

[来自[url=https://rice373.itch.io/why-me]itch.io[/url]]
